name: Open Graph Meta Generator
summary: Generate Open Graph and Twitter Card meta tags with a live social-card preview.
description: Fill in title, description, URL, image, type, and Twitter fields to get copy-ready og:* and twitter:* HTML. Includes a simple large-image card preview and validation tips. Runs locally in your browser.

faqs.question: What tags are generated?
faqs.answer: og:title, og:description, og:type, og:url, og:site_name, og:locale, og:image (+ alt), plus twitter:card/title/description/image/site.

faqs.question: Why absolute image URLs?
faqs.answer: Most social scrapers require a publicly reachable absolute HTTPS URL for og:image.

faqs.question: Does this fetch my page?
faqs.answer: No. You paste values; Forge does not crawl URLs.

faqs.question: Is anything uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Everything runs in your browser.
